references.text: The Jezreel Valley is mentioned as part of Manasseh's territory, bordering the area of Issachar
The Jezreel Valley is the place where the Midianites and Amalekites camped, near the territory of Issachar
Shunem is mentioned as the place where the Philistines camped before the battle in which Saul died
Shunem was the home of the Shunammite woman who showed hospitality to the prophet Elisha
Abishag from Shunem cared for King David in his old age
Kesulloth (Kishon) is mentioned among the cities in Judah's territory, possibly the same place or related
